support.quote: Calculate the average self diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K using molecular dynamics simulations with LAMMPS

Heat the system from 300K to 2500K at a rate of 2.2 K/ps, then equilibrate the liquid at 2500K for 500 ps. Use the Einstein relation to compute the diffusion coefficient from the mean squared displacement (MSD) data
